physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Stephan's Quintet is recorded here: its package frames it at 83,750 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), half the short side of its picture at its distance, a presentation value.

sources.position: NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), HCG 092: position from 2012AJ....143..144S, redshift from 1992ApJ...399..353H (https://ned.ipac.caltech.edu/byname?objname=HCG%20092); NED preferred values of HCG 092: RA 338.9895833°, Dec 33.96° (2012AJ....143..144S); redshift 0.0215 (1992ApJ...399..353H)
sources.distance: Comoving distance of the redshift z = 0.0215 (NED, 1992ApJ...399..353H) in the Planck 2018 cosmology: 94783629.69740579 pc, from Astropy 8.0.1 Planck18.comoving_distance (Planck Collaboration 2020, A&A 641, A6, https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.06209). The project's convention for objects placed by redshift (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
sources.properMotion: Zero: the object is held at its published position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: c z for the redshift z = 0.0215: the redshift written as a velocity, not a motion through space. NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), HCG 092: position from 2012AJ....143..144S, redshift from 1992ApJ...399..353H (https://ned.ipac.caltech.edu/byname?objname=HCG%20092).
